summary: Verified Resend API key rotation. After a supervisor backend restart, POST /api/checkout/session (pickup, cash, delivered@resend.dev) and PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status both trigger Resend HTTP 200 OKs and 'Resend email sent to delivered@resend.dev' log lines (Commande confirmée and Commande acceptée). No 401 Unauthorized from api.resend.com after the restart. All 30 backend tests (7 resend + 23 regression) pass.

minor.issue: Initial run (before I restarted supervisor) showed the currently running uvicorn child process was still using the OLD Resend key — WatchFiles auto-reloads (triggered by test file edits) reload code but do NOT re-read /app/backend/.env because server.py calls load_dotenv() without override=True and the reloader parent's env is inherited by the child. Only a full supervisor restart clears it. After I ran `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, sends returned 200 immediately. Recommend calling `load_dotenv(ROOT_DIR / '.env', override=True)` in server.py so env changes take effect on any code reload without needing a supervisor restart.

action_items: Optional hardening: change server.py line 11 to `load_dotenv(ROOT_DIR / '.env', override=True)` so future key/env rotations without a supervisor restart still take effect after a hot-reload. Not required for user-visible correctness (a supervisor restart already fixed it), but avoids a hidden footgun the next time a key rotates.
critical_code_review_comments: email_service._api_key() reads os.environ each call (good — will pick up new key immediately if the env is refreshed). But server.py's load_dotenv(...) uses default override=False, so once RESEND_API_KEY is set in the reloader-parent env, editing .env alone won't propagate on hot reload. This bit us during this exact iteration.

test_resend_integration.py's assertion 'api.resend.com/emails in fresh' matches both 200 and 401 lines — it should assert on the follow-up 'Resend email sent to' / 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK' string too, otherwise a broken key would be silently reported as passing (as it briefly was on my first run). I did NOT change the test, but flagging for future hardening.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Resend integration verified end-to-end after key rotation to re_B5bcMqLa_CWQNZvStpLswyLECQ3hCNWQJ. Note that ANY future .env rotation without `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` will silently keep the old key active because load_dotenv(override=False) + WatchFiles inherit parent env. Always run supervisorctl restart backend after touching /app/backend/.env, or apply the override=True suggestion above.
rca of the issue: Root cause: the previous Resend API key (re_2xiY1JFt_...) was revoked/rotated on Resend's side, so every send returned 401. Fix by main agent: rotated to re_B5bcMqLa_... in /app/backend/.env. Verification gotcha caught here: on the first test run the current uvicorn child was still using the stale key because it was spawned by a reloader that had cached the old env, and load_dotenv() in server.py uses override=False. After `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, the new key loaded, order BT-2L0E65 produced two consecutive HTTP 200s to api.resend.com and matching 'Resend email sent to delivered@resend.dev' logs for both Commande confirmée and Commande acceptée. No further 401s observed.
